title: Energy and transport
description: Cut the fossil fuel of vehicles, flights, ships, power stations and data centres: its CO₂, the methane leaked supplying it and its air pollution, whose cooling goes too.

electricCars.title: Electric cars
electricCars.description: Cars, buses and two-wheelers run on electricity: their tailpipe CO₂ goes, the grid's CO₂ for charging them comes.

electricTrucks.title: Electric trucks
electricTrucks.description: Trucks and vans run on electricity, which saves less than for cars on a grid that still burns coal.

flyLess.title: Less flying
flyLess.description: Fewer flights: less aviation CO₂, and at once less of the warming from contrails and other effects of flying.

cleanAviationFuel.title: Clean aviation fuel
cleanAviationFuel.description: Fuel made from waste or captured CO₂ cuts the flights' CO₂, not their contrails.

cleanShipping.title: Clean shipping
cleanShipping.description: Ships run on fuels without fossil carbon, such as green ammonia or methanol.

renewableElectricity.title: Renewable electricity
renewableElectricity.description: Wind, solar and other clean power replace coal and gas: the grid's CO₂ per kWh falls, so electric vehicles and data centres save more.

cleanDataCentres.title: Data centres on clean power
cleanDataCentres.description: The extra electricity of AI data centres comes from clean sources; it acts only when that demand is counted (Options).

dataCentres.label: AI data centres
dataCentres.hint: Their electricity growth since 2024 added to the future without the levers (IEA), or the scenarios' electricity as published.
